meta.purpose: Suggestions are proposals for review BEFORE any change is implemented. Nothing in this register has been built unless a separate page shows the built result.
meta.reviewFlow: 1) read the suggestion and its evidence 2) mark ACCEPT / DECLINE / NEED MORE INFO in the Decision column when you decide 3) only then open a task to implement it

suggestions.suggestion: Add a single top-level 'NFL Lines Lab' entry to the main navigation instead of burying the lab inside the NFL page.
suggestions.decisionUnblocked: Whether the lines workstream is a first-class section of the site or a sub-page of the planner.
suggestions.riskIfWrong: Very low. Navigation only; no data changes.
suggestions.status: Proposed - implemented in this pass, listed here for review of the choice

suggestions.suggestion: Publish a single 'today' decision card on the dashboard that states the next free window, the next busy window and what would change each one.
suggestions.decisionUnblocked: Whether the owner needs 'what do I do next' rather than 'what is free'.
suggestions.riskIfWrong: Low. Presentation only; the underlying free/busy engine is unchanged.

suggestions.suggestion: Show every future window with a confidence grade (verified / estimated) directly in the ranking table instead of only in a legend.
suggestions.decisionUnblocked: Whether a reader can rank windows without opening the certainty page.
suggestions.riskIfWrong: Low. Existing certainty policy already exists in the repository.

suggestions.suggestion: Archive the official NFL Game Statistics PDF for every game instead of only parsing the web box score.
suggestions.decisionUnblocked: Whether the lines lab can be extended to play-by-play features (drive, red zone, third down) that the web box score does not carry.
suggestions.riskIfWrong: Medium. PDFs need a parser and the archive is large; the game-book URL is already published in the official schedule feed, so the discovery step is cheap.

suggestions.suggestion: Fetch the official NFL game book for 2024 as well, so player-prop strategies get a third season instead of two.
suggestions.decisionUnblocked: Whether the prop strategy gates can be judged on three seasons rather than two.
suggestions.riskIfWrong: Low. The 2024 schedule and box scores are already reachable; only the fetch volume grows.

suggestions.suggestion: Add a per-row provenance hash for every figure on the lines pages so a published value can be traced to the exact official page and capture time.
suggestions.decisionUnblocked: Whether a reader can trust a number without re-fetching the source themselves.
suggestions.riskIfWrong: Low. The source URL and capture timestamp are already stored per row.

suggestions.suggestion: Record the depth chart 'as of' date and the club's own official/unofficial label on every depth-derived row.
suggestions.decisionUnblocked: How much weight a reader should give a depth chart that the club itself labels unofficial.
suggestions.riskIfWrong: Very low. The label is already captured in the fetch.
suggestions.status: Proposed - implemented in this pass, listed here for review of the choice

suggestions.suggestion: Archive the official weekly injury report for every week of the season, not only the current week.
suggestions.decisionUnblocked: Whether injury-driven signals can be backtested at all, rather than only tracked prospectively.
suggestions.riskIfWrong: Medium. NFL.com publishes the current week only; the historical archive location is an open question (see QN-04).

suggestions.suggestion: Add official game-day inactive lists so 'expected to play' can be separated from 'actually dressed'.
suggestions.decisionUnblocked: Whether a starter who is removed from the game-day roster is caught before the line moves.
suggestions.riskIfWrong: Low. NFL.com publishes an inactives page.

suggestions.suggestion: Add a second model family (an opponent-adjusted possessions model) so the leaderboard can tell whether skill comes from the rating model or from the matchup adjustment.
suggestions.decisionUnblocked: Whether the leaderboard rewards a genuinely new signal or one model with several parameterisations.
suggestions.riskIfWrong: Medium. A second model raises the multiple-testing burden, so the Benjamini-Hochberg step must be re-declared.

suggestions.suggestion: Replace the fixed -110 reference price with a table of declared reference prices (-110, -105, -120) so strategy rankings can be shown against more than one assumed price.
suggestions.decisionUnblocked: Whether the leaderboard order is an artefact of one assumed price.
suggestions.riskIfWrong: Low. Pure recomputation; no new data needed.

suggestions.suggestion: Report a risk-adjusted leaderboard metric (Sharpe ratio of per-bet units) next to the raw reward so a high-variance strategy cannot win on one lucky run.
suggestions.decisionUnblocked: Whether the reward ranking is dominated by variance.
suggestions.riskIfWrong: Low. The per-bet unit series already exists in the committed data.

suggestions.suggestion: Add a walk-forward 'paper trial' period that freezes the current leaderboard and scores only bets placed after the freeze date.
suggestions.decisionUnblocked: Whether the lab can move from historical backtest to prospective evidence.
suggestions.riskIfWrong: Low. The freeze date and schedule already exist in the data.

suggestions.suggestion: Define the reward pool, eligibility, privacy and responsible-play policy before any strategy can earn anything.
suggestions.decisionUnblocked: Whether the leaderboard stays a paper exercise or becomes something with consequences.
suggestions.riskIfWrong: High if skipped. This is the one item that must not be automated.

suggestions.suggestion: Add a 'what changed' panel that lists every figure that moved since the previous deployment, with the reason.
suggestions.decisionUnblocked: Whether a reader can trust that the numbers they saw last week are still current.
suggestions.riskIfWrong: Low. Deployment history is already recorded in COORDINATION.md.
suggestions.evidence: Deployment history recorded in COORDINATION.md; the live site is published from this repository.

suggestions.suggestion: Give every table a column chooser and a CSV export so the same data can be pasted into a spreadsheet.
suggestions.decisionUnblocked: Whether the tables are usable for actual analysis rather than reading.
suggestions.riskIfWrong: Very low. Client-side only.

suggestions.suggestion: Add a print stylesheet so the executive summary and the leaderboard can be printed cleanly for a meeting.
suggestions.decisionUnblocked: Whether the review can happen without the site being open.
suggestions.riskIfWrong: Very low.

suggestions.suggestion: Publish the reconciliation count between the official NFL feed used here and the NFL feed already in the planner, side by side.
suggestions.decisionUnblocked: Whether the two NFL datasets in this repository agree, or whether one is stale.
suggestions.riskIfWrong: Low. Both feeds are official and already committed.

suggestions.suggestion: Move the 49ers, Giants, A's and Stanford/Cal rows out of the 'high priority' scope as soon as their schedules are officially released, and record the release date that triggers the change.
suggestions.decisionUnblocked: How long the planner keeps treating a released schedule as an estimate.
suggestions.riskIfWrong: Low. The release anchors are already tracked in curated/anchors-2026-11-05.json.

suggestions.suggestion: Publish a 'depth deficiency board' that ranks upcoming games by how many starter positions are down to a second, third or fourth string.
suggestions.decisionUnblocked: Which games are most exposed to lineup-driven line movement.
suggestions.riskIfWrong: Medium. Ranking implies a magnitude claim; it should publish the underlying counts only until a magnitude model exists.
